#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import csv, os
from IPython.display import HTML, display

# ── CSV path — absolute based on project root ───────────────────
CSV_PATH = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "data", "publications.csv")

# ── Tag colour mapping ──────────────────────────────────────────
GREEN = {"Geospatial","Google Earth Engine","Soil Carbon","Coastal Agronomy",
         "Conservation Agriculture","Soil Health","Rice Farming","Soil Quality",
         "Agroforestry","Organic Farming","Agronomy","Oat Production",
         "Varietal Selection","Maize","Nutrient Management","Dryland Agriculture",
         "Maize Root Growth","Potassium","Zinc","Zinc Nutrition","Zinc Fertilization",
         "Silicon","Wheat Yield","Soil Fertility","Tillage","Conservation Tillage",
         "Rice Varieties","Phytochemicals","Rice-Wheat System","High-Altitude Agriculture",
         "PGPR","Sustainable Agriculture","Microbial Stimulants","Abiotic Stress",
         "Medicinal Crops","Moisture Stress","Microbial Synergy","Natural Farming",
         "Rice Pest","North-East India","Cotton","Sulphur Nutrition","Rainfed Agriculture",
         "Nutrient Quality","Crop Economics","Legumes","Green Technology","Cropping Patterns"}
AMBER = {"Fodder Quality","Nitrate Toxicity","Fodder Oats","Livestock Systems",
         "Fodder Crops","Livestock Feed","Fodder Maize","Fodder Production",
         "Mycorrhizal Fungi","Forage Crops"}
PURPLE = {"Bibliometrics","Computational Intelligence","Nanobionics",
          "Nanotechnology","Biofortification","Nutrition"}

def tag_cls(t):
    t = t.strip()
    if t in GREEN:  return "ptag-green"
    if t in AMBER:  return "ptag-amber"
    if t in PURPLE: return "ptag-purple"
    return "ptag-blue"

def make_tags(tags_str, sdg_str):
    h = ""
    for t in (tags_str or "").split("|"):
        t = t.strip()
        if t: h += f'<span class="ptag {tag_cls(t)}">{t}</span>'
    for s in (sdg_str or "").split("|"):
        s = s.strip()
        if s: h += f'<span class="ptag ptag-sdg">{s}</span>'
    return h

def pub_card(r):
    year      = r.get("year","")
    ptype     = r.get("type","journal").strip().capitalize()
    title     = r.get("title","")
    journal   = r.get("journal","")
    publisher = r.get("publisher","")
    authors   = r.get("authors","")
    note      = r.get("note","")
    link      = r.get("link","").strip()
    doi       = r.get("doi","").strip()

    meta = f'<span class="pub-journal">{journal}</span>'
    if publisher: meta += f'<span class="pub-sep">&middot;</span><span>{publisher}</span>'
    if authors:   meta += f'<span class="pub-sep">&middot;</span><span class="pub-authors">{authors}</span>'

    note_h  = f'<div class="pub-note">{note}</div>' if note else ""
    links_h = ""
    if link or doi:
        links_h = '<div class="pub-links">'
        if link: links_h += f'<a class="plink plink-dark" href="{link}" target="_blank">Read Paper</a>'
        if doi:  links_h += f'<a class="plink plink-outline" href="{doi}" target="_blank">DOI</a>'
        links_h += '</div>'

    return f"""<div class="pub-card">
  <div class="pub-left"><div class="pub-year-badge">{year}</div><div class="pub-type-label">{ptype}</div></div>
  <div>
    <div class="pub-title">{title}</div>
    <div class="pub-meta">{meta}</div>
    <div class="pub-tags">{make_tags(r.get("tags",""), r.get("sdg_tags",""))}</div>
    {note_h}{links_h}
  </div>
</div>"""

# ── Read CSV ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rows = []
if os.path.exists(CSV_PATH):
    with open(CSV_PATH, newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))

journals = [r for r in rows if r.get("type","").strip().lower() == "journal"]
chapters = [r for r in rows if r.get("type","").strip().lower() == "chapter"]

# ── Build page HTML ─────────────────────────────────────────────
parts = []

parts.append("""<style>
.ptag-sdg{background:#0D2137;color:#5DCAA5;font-weight:700;border:1px solid #1D9E75;}
</style>

<div class="rp-header"><div class="rp-header-inner">
  <div class="rp-label">Publications &amp; Research Output</div>
  <div class="rp-title">Research</div>
  <div class="rp-stats">
    <div class="rp-stat"><div class="rp-snum">60+</div><div class="rp-slbl">Papers</div></div>
    <div class="rp-stat"><div class="rp-snum">15+</div><div class="rp-slbl">Journals</div></div>
    <div class="rp-stat"><div class="rp-snum" id="rp-citations">324</div><div class="rp-slbl">Total Citations</div></div>
    <div class="rp-stat"><div class="rp-snum" id="rp-hindex">9</div><div class="rp-slbl">h-index</div></div>
    <div class="rp-stat"><div class="rp-snum">2017&ndash;2026</div><div class="rp-slbl">Publication Span</div></div>
  </div>
</div></div>
<script>
fetch('/data/citations.json')
  .then(function(r){return r.json();})
  .then(function(d){
    document.getElementById('rp-citations').textContent=d.citations_total;
    document.getElementById('rp-hindex').textContent=d.h_index;
  }).catch(function(){});
</script>""")

parts.append(f"""
<div class="rp-nav"><div class="rp-nav-inner">
  <a href="#journal-articles">Journal Articles <span class="rp-nav-count">{len(journals)}</span></a>
  <a href="#book-chapters">Book Chapters <span class="rp-nav-count">{len(chapters)}</span></a>
  <a href="#phd-thesis">PhD Thesis</a>
  <a href="#ongoing-research">Ongoing Research</a>
</div></div>

<div class="rp-body"><div class="rp-body-inner">

<div class="rp-legend">
  <div class="rp-legend-title">Tag colours:</div>
  <div class="rp-legend-item"><div class="rp-legend-dot" style="background:#085041;"></div>Geospatial &amp; Agronomy</div>
  <div class="rp-legend-item"><div class="rp-legend-dot" style="background:#0C447C;"></div>Climate &amp; Policy</div>
  <div class="rp-legend-item"><div class="rp-legend-dot" style="background:#633806;"></div>Fodder &amp; Livestock</div>
  <div class="rp-legend-item"><div class="rp-legend-dot" style="background:#3C3489;"></div>Bibliometrics &amp; Technology</div>
  <div class="rp-legend-item"><div class="rp-legend-dot" style="background:#1D9E75;"></div>SDG Alignment</div>
</div>""")

# Journal Articles
parts.append(f"""
<div class="rp-sec-header" id="journal-articles">
  <div class="rp-sec-title">Journal Articles</div>
  <div class="rp-sec-count">{len(journals)} papers</div>
  <div class="rp-sec-line"></div>
</div>""")
for r in journals:
    parts.append(pub_card(r))

# Book Chapters
parts.append(f"""
<div class="rp-sec-header" id="book-chapters">
  <div class="rp-sec-title">Book Chapters</div>
  <div class="rp-sec-count">{len(chapters)} chapters</div>
  <div class="rp-sec-line"></div>
</div>""")
for r in chapters:
    parts.append(pub_card(r))

# PhD Thesis
parts.append("""
<div class="rp-sec-header" id="phd-thesis">
  <div class="rp-sec-title">PhD Thesis</div>
  <div class="rp-sec-line"></div>
</div>
<div class="thesis-card">
  <div style="display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px;">
    <div style="flex-shrink:0;">
      <div class="pub-year-badge" style="width:52px;">2023</div>
      <div class="pub-type-label">PhD</div>
    </div>
    <div>
      <div class="thesis-title">Performance of Wheat&ndash;Maize&ndash;Cowpea Cropping Sequence Under Continuous Use of Municipal Solid Waste Compost</div>
      <div class="thesis-meta">ICAR &ndash; National Dairy Research Institute, Karnal, Haryana &nbsp;&middot;&nbsp; Doctoral Dissertation</div>
      <div class="pub-tags" style="margin-bottom:8px;">
        <span class="ptag ptag-green">Cropping Systems</span>
        <span class="ptag ptag-blue">MSW Compost</span>
        <span class="ptag ptag-green">Soil Health</span>
        <span class="ptag ptag-amber">Carbon Cycling</span>
        <span class="ptag ptag-sdg">SDG 2</span>
        <span class="ptag ptag-sdg">SDG 12</span>
        <span class="ptag ptag-sdg">SDG 15</span>
      </div>
      <div class="thesis-note">Doctoral research examining how continuous application of municipal solid waste compost affects productivity and soil quality in wheat&ndash;maize&ndash;cowpea cropping sequences. Established foundational knowledge on organic waste recycling in agriculture &mdash; contributing to both soil health and circular economy goals.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>""")

# Ongoing Research
parts.append("""
<div class="rp-sec-header" id="ongoing-research">
  <div class="rp-sec-title">Ongoing Research</div>
  <div class="rp-sec-line"></div>
</div>
<div class="ongoing-card">
  <div class="ongoing-item">
    <div class="ongoing-dot"></div>
    <div>Geospatial assessment of coastal agricultural vulnerability using Google Earth Engine and multi-temporal remote sensing data</div>
  </div>
  <div class="ongoing-item">
    <div class="ongoing-dot"></div>
    <div>Soil health monitoring in rice-based cropping systems of coastal Goa &mdash; seasonal dynamics of biological and chemical indicators</div>
  </div>
  <div class="ongoing-item">
    <div class="ongoing-dot"></div>
    <div>Climate adaptation strategies for coastal farming communities in Goa &mdash; participatory assessment and policy framework development</div>
  </div>
</div>

</div></div>""")

display(HTML("\n".join(parts)))
